scenario.zh:
你答应帮朋友完成一件事。
明天就要交。
今晚发现只完成了一半。
你最可能会——
scenario.en:
You promised to help a friend finish something.
It’s due tomorrow.
Tonight you realize you’re only halfway done.
What would you most likely do?

text.en: Pull an all-nighter and deliver on time

interpretation.zh: 答应了的事，你可能宁可自己扛一晚，也不想让它落空。
interpretation.en: Once you’ve said yes, you may rather carry a rough night than let it fall through.

options.immediate: 用户把承诺兑现放在自己的成本之前。

text.zh: 现在就告诉对方可能要晚一点
text.en: Tell them right now it might be late

interpretation.zh: 你可能觉得，坏消息越早说，越是对对方负责。
interpretation.en: Bad news early may feel to you like the responsible version of bad news.

options.immediate: 用户及时同步风险，直面而不拖延。

text.zh: 先把完成的一部分发过去
text.en: Send over the finished half first

interpretation.zh: 你可能习惯先交出手里有的——让事情先走起来。
interpretation.en: You may like handing over what you have — keep things moving first.

options.immediate: 用户用可交付的部分先推进，务实止损。

text.en: Explain tomorrow when I hand it in

interpretation.zh: 你可能更愿意先把今晚过完，把解释留给明天的自己。
interpretation.en: You may prefer to finish tonight in peace and leave the explaining to tomorrow’s you.

options.immediate: 用户暂缓摩擦性沟通，先维持表面的平稳。
